payload.name: Endowment effect
payload.fact: The endowment effect suggests that product ownership is perceived more strongly through the perception of possession than through actual physical possession.
payload.boundary: Consumer behavior and remote purchase environments

provenance.title: Remote Purchase Environments: The Influence of Return Policy Leniency on Two-Stage Decision Processes
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results from three experiments provide support for the idea that product ownership depends more on perception than possession
